$description: SYSTEM colour roles, LIGHT mode (Monograph paper, 0500) — what a colour is FOR. Same names as mode.dark.json.

surface.$description: Panels sit on the same paper; hairlines separate them, not tints.

surface-raised.$description: The well — the one tinted surface: inputs, preview plate, hover and selected rows, user messages.

border.$description: The 1px hairline between rows and panes.

border-strong.$description: The strong 1px ink rule that opens a block.

text-muted.$description: Caption grey — AA on paper and well; never dim with opacity (0376).

text-faint.$description: Placeholders only — must read as absence, not content.

accent.$description: Highlight is INK (0501): primary fill, selected segment, active underline. Red is reserved for problems.

accent-hover.$description: Soft ink — the primary's hover and press.

on-accent.$description: Paper text on an ink fill.

danger.$description: Errors — always with an icon and words (0501).

shadow.$description: Shadow ink — for what sits above the page only.
